# F2: Fit and finish, forms-checkin

A check of the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/finish/2-forms-checkin.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured, and a limit its words don’t give is added after it, in the script’s test (“its test: …”).

## What it checks

fit and finish, forms-checkin (per-area reports, 4 Nov). The check-in (CheckInFlow) and the one-table check-in (QuickCheckIn). Check-in #3 (the chart) is area 4's.
